status: Fictional evaluation fixture, not a company dataset

definitions.total: Unique ticket IDs after excluding only the explicitly labeled accidental copy.
definitions.overdue: Open tickets with a supplied due date strictly before snapshot_date.
definitions.due_today: Open tickets with a due date equal to snapshot_date; not overdue.
definitions.unknown_due: Open tickets with no due date; neither on-time nor overdue is established.
